"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reverse-words-in-a-string-iii/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

557. Reverse Words in a String III

Given a string s, reverse the order of characters in each word within a sentence while still preserving whitespace and initial word order.

Example 1:

Input: s = "Let's take LeetCode contest"
Output: "s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc"

Example 2:

Input: s = "Mr Ding"
Output: "rM gniD"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 5 * 10^4
    s contains printable ASCII characters.
    s does not contain any leading or trailing spaces.
    There is at least one word in s.
    All the words in s are separated by a single space.
"""


class Solution:
    def reverseWords(self, s: str) -> str:
        return " ".join(word[::-1] for word in s.split())


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reverseWords("Let's take LeetCode contest"))  # "s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc"

assert sol.reverseWords("Let's take LeetCode contest") == "s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc"
assert sol.reverseWords("Mr Ding") == "rM gniD"

assert sol.reverseWords("a") == "a"
assert sol.reverseWords("ab") == "ba"
assert sol.reverseWords("a b c d e") == "a b c d e"
assert (
    sol.reverseWords("hello hello hello hello hello") == "olleh olleh olleh olleh olleh"
)
assert sol.reverseWords("123 456 7890") == "321 654 0987"
assert sol.reverseWords("!@# $%^ &*()") == "#@! ^%$ )(*&"
assert sol.reverseWords("singleword") == "drowelgnis"
assert (
    sol.reverseWords("a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z")
    == "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z"
)
assert (
    sol.reverseWords("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")
    == "ehT kciuq nworb xof spmuj revo eht yzal god"
)
assert (
    sol.reverseWords("  leading and trailing spaces  ".strip())
    == "gnidael dna gniliart secaps"
)
